t: A passively cooled Reactor is a Reactor that $(l:bigreactors:reactor/innerworking)generates energy$(/l) directly and that does not use an external medium to dissipate it's internal heat.$(br2)The $(l:bigreactors:intro/first)first Reactor$(/l) described in the early pages of this book is a Reactor operating in Passive Cooling mode.
被动冷却反应堆是一种$(l:bigreactors:reactor/innerworking)直接产生能量$(/l)的反应堆，它不依赖外部介质来散发内部热量。$(br2)本书前几页中介绍的$(l:bigreactors:intro/first)第一种反应堆$(/l)，就是以被动冷却模式运行的反应堆。
